prompt: eqtl_enrichment.csv has one row per eQTL variant-biosample pair with columns category (unmatched / same_lineage / same_cell_type) and enrichment. Plot the three distributions as violins with a median point-interval, in the style of Fig. 5b of the scE2G paper, with significance brackets between the groups (use a Wilcoxon test and show the P values), category labels with n under the axis, and save as eqtl_violin.pdf and .png.
assertions: Violins are filled #8B98AC / #9A3983 / #260032 with no outline stroke
Point-interval lines are two weights, about 0.77 pt and 1.79 pt, in black
Brackets are 0.25 pt lines with stars below and P values above
Axis lines are 0.25 pt and text sizes include 5.5 and 6.5 pt with nothing below 4.5 pt (superscripts excepted)
Category labels with italic n appear under the axis
